videos.title: Stars, Stripes, VIPs and Protests: Brussels hosts US Independence bash
videos.transcript: Thousands of guests traveled down to Brussels on Sunday to celebrate the 250th anniversary of US independence. The invite-only event is held in a large park in the Belgian capital, which is located near the EU institutions. >> And everyone gathered in Brussels to celebrate 250 years of American independence. >> US [music] Ambassador to Belgium Bill White opened the ceremony. Among those attending are Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, and European [music] Parliament President Roberta Metsola. US military personnel based in the Belgian capital are also in attendance. However, the event drew widespread criticism. On Sunday morning, Greenpeace unrolled a massive banner in the city center condemning the occasion to promote Trump's political and corporate agenda. And several organizations, including Extinction Rebellion and Rise for Climate, demonstrated outside of the park in protest against the privatization of the public park.
videos.summary: Brussels hosted a large invitation-only event on Sunday to mark the 250th anniversary of American independence. Senior European and NATO officials attended the ceremony, which was opened by the US Ambassador to Belgium. At the same time, several environmental groups staged protests outside the venue.

videos.title: Anthropic claims Alibaba unlawfully copied Claude’s capabilities
videos.transcript: Anthropic has accused Chinese tech giant Alibaba of extracting its claw AI technology in what it says is the largest known attack of its kind. That is according to a letter seen by Reuters. The US AI company said Alibaba carried out a distillation operation earlier this year that involves using outputs from a powerful AI to train a cheaper model, effectively copying its abilities. Anthropic says the operation used nearly 25,000 fake accounts to generate more than 28.8 million interactions with Claude. It linked the campaign to operators affiliated with Alibaba and its AI lab Quinn and it warned that distillation could help China catch up with its advanced capabilities. The accusations remain in a letter sent on June 10th to Senators Tim Scott and Elizabeth Warren ahead of a US Senate Banking Committee hearing on AI back in February. Anthropic said it faced attacks by Chinese AI outfits including Deep Seek. Alibaba did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the latest accusations.
videos.summary: Anthropic, a US artificial intelligence company, has accused Chinese tech giant Alibaba of illegally copying its Claude AI system using a method called distillation. According to a letter seen by Reuters, nearly 25,000 fake accounts were used to generate millions of interactions with Claude. Alibaba has not yet responded to the accusations.

videos.title: Cost of doing nothing for environment is costly
videos.transcript: We want clean water. We want clean air. We We need healthy soils. And And that is one reason I think we need. And I'm not sure that it always has to cost more money. It's more doing thing more efficiently, using new techniques, using AI, using digitalization. I think that is one part. The other part is that we today again see that dependencies cost. And that is something that me as a consumer at the end of the day is paying the price for. So, we need to treat our environment. We need to get in a a more sustainable way because that is the future proof. So, of course we can discuss and we can put plaster on the things at the moment, but that will only uh postpone the cost. videos.transcript: Well, there are not many people out and about as you can imagine this morning. But in other places, southern states for example, people are just having to hang tight. Power has been knocked out. In some states, some people are without ways to heat their homes right now. Other people, they're trying to find some fun where they can. They're out sledging. A few impromptu snowball fights springing up. But certainly, people are just hanging tight because we're expecting some record snowfall. And it's not just the snow. I've got to tell you, it is absolutely freezing here. And that really gets your bonus.
